title: "The Bond Films"
---

This page looks at how James Bond movies performed at the box office over time.

::: {#2d5145d6 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```
:::


The Bond movies in this dataset were released between 1995 and 2021.

::: {#7a0c4072 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.show()
```
